title: Cobra

steps.text: Lie face down with your legs long behind you.
Place your hands beside your chest with your elbows close to your body.
steps.cue: Hands beside your chest, elbows close.

steps.text: Press lightly into your hands and lift your chest a small amount.
steps.cue: Press lightly. Lift your chest a little.

steps.text: Keep your shoulders down and hold for a couple of breaths.
Lower slowly and rest your cheek on the mat.
steps.cue: Lower slowly. Rest your cheek on the mat.

mistakes: Pressing up so far that the lower back feels pinched.
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.
regression: Keep your forearms on the mat and lift only your head and chest.
stopIf: Come down if you feel pinching in your lower back.

anatomy.why: The muscles along the spine lift the chest; the hands only steady you.
